Overview

This feature service provides mapped information for municipal water hydrants in Peachland, British Columbia. It supports operational water system management by documenting hydrant locations and key attributes used for field reference and fire protection planning.

Feature Layers

  • Peachland Water Hydrants: A point layer of water hydrants with location, installation, and status information. The layer also includes pressure zone, available fireflow, and fireflow disclaimer details that were populated from Peachland's water model and support ongoing utility planning and emergency response.

Geographic Coverage

The data covers The District of Peachland in British Columbia within the Regional District of Central Okanagan

Use Cases

  • Water utility operations and asset reference
  • Fire protection and emergency response planning
  • Hydrant location lookup and field verification
  • Water model-based fireflow assessment

Source and Usage

The layer is owned by The District of Peachland maintained by the GIS Section of the Regional District of Central Okanagan. The service is shared under the Regional District of Central Okanagan open data license and disclaimer terms.
